数据包"}],"。"]}],"\n",["$","li",null,{"children":[["$","strong",null,{"children":"截断失效"}],"：对于分片的 Client Hello，SNI 扩展虽然通常在第一个包中，但由于 TLS Record Layer 的 ",["$","code",null,{"children":"Length"}]," Positive），DPI 采取了 ",["$","strong",null,{"children":"Fail-Open"}]," 策略，即 ",["$","strong",null,{"children":"“看不懂就行”"}],"。"]}],"\n"]}],"\n",["$","h4",null,{"id":"33-关键抓包证据-wireshark-frames","children":"3.3 关键抓包证据 (Wireshark
